text:
Ravi: Short poll 11 where do you stash your router? Trying to fix evening lag. Pics welcome.
Tess: On top of a tall bookshelf 334. Works well for coverage.
Omar: Desk, right beside monitor. Aesthetics > everything.
Liz: Under my desk in a cable box 62c. Not ideal.
Ravi: Options: 1) Book/shelf 2) Desk 3) Under-desk/box 4) Window/balcony 5) Ceiling/mounted 1 reply number to vote
Tess: 1
Omar: 2, but moving it soon after reading this thread
Liz: 3, but thinking of moving it out. Too many signals bouncing off the TV.
NetBot: Tip: enable 5GHz, pick non-overlapping channels, and avoid microwaves. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/home-networking
Ravi: Anyone tried USB extension to move the router up?
Tess: I used a 2m extension for my AP, huge improvement.
Omar: Also shoutout to @Tess for recommending a simple channel scan app 44d
Ravi: Final tally: 1x bookshelf, 1x desk, 1x under-desk. Thanks all, will try elevation + 5GHz tonight and report back with pics.
